brief.name: Notebook evidence card
brief.purpose: Open notebook with distinct observation, hypothesis and freshness shapes; labels outside image
brief.learningIntent: O02 / LO3; observations and ideas are separate
brief.plannedMethod: Actual OpenAI base imagery with preserved original output; all exact labels/values in semantic UI, with manual diagrams/edits truthfully recorded

binding.alt: An open notebook pairs a square eye card with a round question balloon and a separate clock tab.
binding.caption: Use the eye card to record what you observed, the question balloon for a testable hypothesis and the clock tab to check the reading’s freshness. Changing the configuration can leave an earlier measurement stale.

conversion: Scale the full uncropped frame with Lanczos and encode RGB WebP at quality 88, method 6. No retouching or labels in the derivative.
